messages.subject: as.quoted with names with spaces
parts:
Hi,

The plyr package currently does not handle variable names with spaces
in them:


> df <- data.frame(x = c(1,2,3))
> df$"Column Name" <- c(4,5,6)
> df
x Column Name
1 1 4
2 2 5
3 3 6
> ddply(df, .variable=c("x"), sum)
x V1
1 1 5
2 2 7
3 3 9
> ddply(df, .variable=c("Column Name"), sum)
Error in parse(text = x) : unexpected symbol in "Column Name"

Is this a bug that can be fixed?

Short of renaming columns is there anything that can be used a
preprocessing step or as a workaround?


Thanks,
Matt

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: as.quoted with names with spaces
parts:
For now, surround the name in back ticks. This is the standard r
escaping mechanism.
Hadley
